results.title: What Private Equity Investors Want: 5 Metrics
results.content: # What Private Equity Investors Want: 5 Metrics. Private equity funds are numbers driven. One of the first things they do when they purchase a business or make a big investment is to expand the business’s information systems. It almost always identifies where the company’s cash flow is coming from (and going). Private equity managers view this “professionalization” of a company’s systems as something that will help it sell your company to the next larger, more sophisticated financial buyer. Before digging into the details of your current information system, the buyers will want to meet with with you. **Cash flow** Although net income is important (no one wants to own a business that isn’t making money), private equity managers are fixated on cash flow. Increased EBITDA is what’s going to allow them to eventually sell your business for more than they paid you. **Liquidity** Your controller, bookkeeper, or chief financial officer (if you had one) was probably managing your company’s liquidity needs, balancing any seasonality in your business with credit availability. Liquidity is going to become more of an issue, because the private equity fund probably used some leverage to buy your company. Private equity managers will want weekly, monthly, and quarterly cash flow models (perhaps even daily in a crisis) to make sure your company stays within the liquidity covenants negotiated with its lenders. Meet the Company That Can Make Jet Fuel Out of Thin Air. Meet the Company That Can Make Jet Fuel Out of Thin Air. 0 seconds of 8 minutes, 18 seconds. **Product-by-product analysis** Cost accounting can be tricky in complex companies, and small firms can often lose track of where they are really making profits and generating cash. In service businesses, expect a focus on how contracts are bid and a particular emphasis on avoiding contracts that increase revenue but aren’t all that profitable. **Industry-specific metrics** Each business will have its own key metrics—and they may surprise you. Often a good common-sense look by a new set of eyes (in this case, the private equity fund) will give you a better idea of which metrics you really should be concentrating on. Metrics become the backbone of how the private equity fund thinks about the company—so be ready to embrace them.

results.title: How To Calculate Modulus Of Elasticity Of Concrete Mix
results.content: # What is the Modulus of Elasticity of Concrete Mix? The **Modulus of Elasticity of concrete mix** stands as one of the most crucial **mechanical properties of concrete** in the realm of structural engineering. For the aspiring student, the seasoned civil engineer, and the dedicated researcher, this guide will explore the **modulus of elasticity of concrete** in its entirety—covering its **definition, formula (IS 456:2000, ACI 318, Eurocode 2), calculation examples, influencing factors, and practical applications** in structural design. ## What is the Modulus of Elasticity? The ***Modulus of Elasticity (E),*** also known as ***Young’s Modulus,*** quantifies the relationship between ***stress*** ***(force per unit area)***and strain ***(proportional deformation)*** within a material’s elastic range. A ***high modulus value*** signifies a ***stiffer concrete,*** meaning it will deform less under a given load. * **Secant Modulus:** The slope of a line drawn from the origin to a specified point on the ***stress-strain*** curve, often corresponding to 40% of the concrete’s ultimate compressive strength (f’c). * **Dynamic Modulus of Elasticity:** This is determined using non-destructive methods, such as measuring the velocity of ultrasonic pulses through the concrete. ## Key Factors Influencing the Modulus of Elasticity of a Concrete Mix. * **Age of Concrete:** The modulus of elasticity increases with age as the concrete continues to hydrate and gain strength. Moist-cured concrete generally exhibits a higher modulus of elasticity compared to air-cured concrete, which can suffer from shrinkage and micro-cracking. For instance, the inclusion of recycled concrete aggregate (RCA) can reduce the elastic modulus due to the softer adhered mortar. Various international design codes provide empirical formulas to estimate the secant modulus of elasticity (Ec) based on concrete’s compressive strength and, in some cases, its density. * **Seismic Design:** In earthquake-prone regions, the stiffness of a structure, governed by its modulus of elasticity, is critical. * **Prestressed Concrete:** In prestressed concrete, a high modulus of elasticity is desirable. The Modulus of Elasticity of a concrete mix is a dynamic and multifaceted property, far more complex than a single formula can capture. ### What is the difference between modulus of elasticity in steel and concrete? ### How is modulus of elasticity tested?
